## Maintenance

`INDEX.md` is hand-maintained or regenerated by `/ledger reindex`
(P1). Each pointer line fits one terminal width (~120 chars). If a
line grows past 120 chars, the title or summary is too long and the
cairn itself probably has the right thing in its `title:` frontmatter
or `## Status` opening sentence -- adjust there, not here.

## Archive

Superseded or rejected cairns remain on the file system but drop out
of the active index. Reach them via `/ledger query --status
superseded` (P1) or by reading the archive section below if
hand-maintained.
